paragraphs.text:
Jahark offers to come with you. If you accept him, he accompanies 
you as long as you wish, as long as you are in Egypt. Use Jahark 
whenever you wish to substitute his skills for yours. Y ou may even 
deliberately sacrifice him in an encounter and emerge unscathed, 
if you are that sort.
Copy his statistics onto a blank investigator sheet. When you 
have done that, go to 149.
